metadata.description: Agent skills for neuroimaging meta-analysis with NiMARE.

plugins.name: nimare-skills
plugins.description: Skills for running statistically defensible neuroimaging meta-analyses with NiMARE: ALE and other coordinate-based methods, image-based meta-analysis, MACM, functional decoding against Neurosynth/NeuroQuery, dataset curation and contrast-independence auditing, and reporting.
